title: Big-Bang Client Reorg Cutover
pattern: Combining a major system technical cutover with a simultaneous structural reorganization of the engineering teams and their communication channels.
why_bad: Organizational restructuring is highly traumatic and disrupts existing informal communication paths. Executing it concurrently with a critical system release makes it nearly impossible to coordinate incident response and debug initial production failures, causing prolonged outages [595, 609].
detection: The scheduling of major team structural reorgs to occur concurrently with (or within the same sprint as) a major legacy technical cutover or database migration.
counterexample: None. Coupling organizational trauma to critical technical releases violates basic operational safety principles.
fix: Decouple the reorg from the release: stabilize the rewritten system in production first under the existing team structure, then gradually phase in the organizational reorg [595, 609].
source: Kill It with Fire, "Design as Destiny" [149, 150, 595, 609]
